Nvidia and Megaspeed have firmly denied any ties to espionage activities.

Why new LNG projects may not prevent a global gas crunch this winter
summary: Global liquefied natural gas supplies are facing unprecedented challenges due to ongoing disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz. The International Energy Agency reports that LNG loadings from Qatar and the UAE have decreased significantly. As a result, global LNG output is projected to fall between 10 and 25 billion cubic meters during winter.

summary: Bushra Bibi is serving a seven-year sentence in the £190 million corruption case.

headline: LPG availability, fair pricing among govt priorities, says petroleum minister
summary: Petroleum Minister Ali Pervaiz Malik said on Saturday that addressing public concerns over the availability and unfair pricing of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) was a government priority. Earlier this week, the government unveiled a new LPG policy, aimed at creating competition and supplies through procurement by four state-owned enterprises (SOEs) under government-to-government (G2G) and business-to-business (B2B) arrangements. The government directed four state-owned enterprises to re-enter the LPG import business to ease severe supply constraints and soaring prices.

headline: Abbas eyes maiden five-wicket haul on home soil as Pakistan prepare for Sri Lanka Tests
summary: Veteran fast bowler Mohammad Abbas is targeting a maiden five-wicket haul on home soil as Pakistan prepare for their two-Test series against Sri Lanka, hoping to add a missing milestone to an otherwise impressive Test career. Speaking on the sidelines of the team’s practice session at the Islamabad Club on Saturday, Abbas expressed satisfaction with his current form and vowed to maintain his consistency.

headline: Iran says forces ‘stronger’ than at beginning of war
summary: Iran said Saturday its military has grown “stronger” since the outset of its war with the United States, which has offered a $20 million reward for information about Tehran’s nuclear programme. Mediators have been working to prevent any resumption of fighting after months of deadlock in the Middle East conflict, which began when the United States and Israel attacked Iran in late February.

headline: Pakistan, Sudan to sign MoU on cybercrime cooperation
summary: ISLAMABAD: Pakistan and Sudan on Saturday decided to sign a memorandum of understanding (MoU) to enhance cooperation in combating cybercrime, according to a statement issued by the Ministry of Interior. The decision was taken during delegation-level talks between Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi and visiting Sudanese Interior Minister Lt Gen Babiker Samra Mustafa Ali at the Ministry of Interior. Minister of State for Interior Tallal Chaudhry also attended the meeting.

headline: Pakistan warns UN against weakening peacekeeping amid budget cuts
summary: UNITED NATIONS: Pakistan has urged the United Nations not to allow financial constraints and cost-cutting measures to weaken its peacekeeping operations, warning that reductions in resources could undermine the organisation’s ability to maintain international peace and security. The warning comes as UN peacekeeping faces mounting financial and political pressures. The General Assembly has approved a $5.1 billion budget for peacekeeping operations for 2026-27, about 10 per cent lower than the previous year’s allocation.

headline: JUI-F decries ‘coordinated campaign’ against Fazl
summary: Slams alleged drone filming of leaders’ homes, character assassination on social media. Maulana calls for transparency in foreign investment deals. QUETTA / LARKANA: The JUI-F staged protests in different parts of Sindh and Balochistan on Friday, decrying what it called a “coordinated character assassination campaign” against its leader, Maulana Fazlur Rehman.

headline: New state lounge planned at Islamabad airport ahead of SCO summit
summary: RAWALPINDI: The Pakistan Airports Authority (PAA) has initiated construction of a new State Lounge at Islamabad International Airport as part of Pakistan’s preparations for the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Summit scheduled to be hosted in Islamabad in August 2027. Defence Minister Khawaja Mohammad Asif performed the groundbreaking for the new lounge. The ceremony was attended by Secretary Defence Mohammad Ali, PAA Director General AVM Mohammad Shahid Afzaal and senior officials from the Ministry of Defence and the PAA.

headline: LHC rejects plea for directions to legislation on marital rape
summary: LAHORE: The Lahore High Court (LHC) has dismissed a public interest petition seeking directions to the federal and provincial governments to legislate on marital rape, holding that a constitutional court cannot compel the legislature to enact a particular law or create a new offence. Justice Abher Gul Khan clarified that the ruling neither endorses violence or abuse within marriage, nor prevents the Parliament or any provincial assembly from taking up the matter.

headline: KP to introduce mobile drug testing labs
summary: PESHAWAR: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa will introduce five advanced mobile drug screening laboratories next week to strengthen the monitoring of medicines and detect substandard, counterfeit and suspicious drugs in markets across the province. Adviser to the governor on health and population Nigar Johar Khan reviewed the newly equipped laboratory vans during her visit to the Directorate General of Drug Control and Pharmacy Services on Friday. The five mobile laboratories will be formally inaugurated at Governor House next Tuesday.

headline: Punjab Revenue Authority wants electronic invoice system at all hotels, restaurants
summary: LAHORE: Punjab Revenue Authority (PRA) has sought all hotels and restaurants to be equipped with the electronic invoice monitoring system (EIMS) for timely payment of taxes. It was sought by the authorities in a meeting with the Hotels and Restaurant Association held here on Friday. During the meeting, matters concerning installation of EIMS in the hotel industry and tax compliance came under discussion.

headline: Democratic victories bring historic breakthroughs for women and minorities
summary: Voters across the US elected a historic slate of women, candidates of colour and other underrepresented politicians on Tuesday, reshaping the face of political leadership as Democrats rode a wave of dissatisfaction with President Donald Trump’s administration to major gains nationwide. Democrats flipped control of both the House of Representatives and Senate while winning key statewide races, delivering a series of milestone victories.

headline: Lost in translation? Japanese minister blames X for diplomatic embarrassment
summary: TOKYO: A Japanese minister blamed Elon Musk’s X social media platform on Friday for almost plunging him into diplomatic hot water, after its automatic translation feature implied he did not know the names of world leaders he was meeting. Trade Minister Ryosei Akazawa assured reporters that he knew the identity of the current prime minister of Bangladesh after a post with photos of the two included the name of ousted premier Sheikh Hasina in its translated version.

headline: Making the most of America’s midterm tsunami
summary: Imagine, for a moment, that the US midterm elections had not delivered Democratic wins at a generational scale, but merely a trickle of flipped seats—enough, perhaps, to change control of the House of Representatives but not enough for a Senate majority. Is there any doubt that President Donald Trump would embrace such results as a good-enough validation of his often lawless and brutal administration?

headline: Just like cars, Chinese motorcycles out to conquer Europe
summary: Just as with electric cars, Chinese motorcycle brands are roaring into European markets, with high-performance, cut‑price models starting to make a name for themselves. At EICMA in Milan, Europe’s biggest motorcycle show, visitors were jostling on Friday around the stand of CFMoto, one of the main Chinese brands sold in Europe. The firm from Hangzhou has gained attention by producing engines and assembling models for Austria’s KTM, then by winning two Moto3 (250cc) championships in 2024 and 2026.
